# ETSettings.AnimationSettings { #DeToX.ETSettings.AnimationSettings }

```python
ETSettings.AnimationSettings(
    focus_time=0.5,
    zoom_speed=6.0,
    attention_zoom_max_size_big=0.16,
    attention_zoom_min_size_big=0.095,
    collection_zoom_max_size_big=0.095,
    collection_zoom_min_size_big=0.05,
    attention_trill_size_big=0.1275,
    collection_trill_size_big=0.0725,
    attention_zoom_max_size_small=0.06,
    attention_zoom_min_size_small=0.03,
    collection_zoom_max_size_small=0.03,
    collection_zoom_min_size_small=0.01,
    attention_trill_size_small=0.045,
    collection_trill_size_small=0.02,
    attention_trill_rotation_range=20,
    collection_trill_rotation_range=30,
    trill_cycle_duration=1.5,
    trill_active_duration=1.1,
    trill_frequency=3.0,
)
```

Animation parameters for calibration stimuli.

Calibration uses two animation phases. The attention phase attracts the
participant before collection. The collection phase holds attention while gaze
samples are acquired. Every attention and collection size is configured
independently; values are not derived from one another at runtime.

All size parameters are specified in height units (percentage of screen
height). Collection values should normally remain smaller than the
corresponding attention values.

Two size presets are available:
- **big**: Larger stimuli recommended for infants/children (default)
- **small**: Smaller stimuli recommended for adults

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| focus_time | [float](`float`) | Wait time before collection. Default `0.5` seconds. |
| zoom_speed | [float](`float`) | Shared zoom speed multiplier. Default `6.0`. |
| attention_zoom_max_size_big | [float](`float`) | Largest big-preset attention zoom size. Default `0.16` (16% of screen height). |
| attention_zoom_min_size_big | [float](`float`) | Smallest big-preset attention zoom size. Default `0.095` (9.5%). |
| collection_zoom_max_size_big | [float](`float`) | Largest big-preset collection zoom size. Default `0.095` (9.5%). |
| collection_zoom_min_size_big | [float](`float`) | Smallest big-preset collection zoom size. Default `0.05` (5%). |
| attention_trill_size_big | [float](`float`) | Fixed big-preset attention trill size. Default `0.1275` (12.75%). |
| collection_trill_size_big | [float](`float`) | Fixed big-preset collection trill size. Default `0.0725` (7.25%). |
| attention_zoom_max_size_small | [float](`float`) | Largest small-preset attention zoom size. Default `0.06` (6%). |
| attention_zoom_min_size_small | [float](`float`) | Smallest small-preset attention zoom size. Default `0.03` (3%). |
| collection_zoom_max_size_small | [float](`float`) | Largest small-preset collection zoom size. Default `0.03` (3%). |
| collection_zoom_min_size_small | [float](`float`) | Smallest small-preset collection zoom size. Default `0.01` (1%). |
| attention_trill_size_small | [float](`float`) | Fixed small-preset attention trill size. Default `0.045` (4.5%). |
| collection_trill_size_small | [float](`float`) | Fixed small-preset collection trill size. Default `0.02` (2%). |
| attention_trill_rotation_range | [float](`float`) | Maximum attention trill rotation in degrees. Default `20`. |
| collection_trill_rotation_range | [float](`float`) | Maximum collection trill rotation in degrees. Default `30`. |
| trill_cycle_duration | [float](`float`) | Active-plus-pause trill cycle in seconds. Default `1.5`. |
| trill_active_duration | [float](`float`) | Active rotation within each trill cycle. Default `1.1` seconds. |
| trill_frequency | [float](`float`) | Rotation oscillations per second. Default `3.0`. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from DeToX import ETSettings as cfg
>>> settings = cfg.animation
>>> settings.attention_zoom_max_size_big = 0.18
>>> settings.collection_zoom_min_size_big = 0.04
>>> settings.collection_trill_rotation_range = 35
```
